strings: r_c0 can only set aside a nest and some herbs for {PRONOUN/m_c/object} when m_c comes in complaining of joint pain.
m_c has been complaining for days, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} joints seem to be giving them particular trouble this moon.
After the work that m_c has put into helping the apprentices care for the elders, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} left with aches all over.
